item.name: Cars & Motorcycles Dealership
item.about: One of the main locations that serve as the key and only spawnpoint upon joining the game. Here players can purchase vehicles and motorcycles by walking up to the desk as they enter the main entrance of the dealership. item.name: Boats Dealership
item.about: A distinct dealership located in Downtown Wayfort where players can purchase boats. The interior of the building features a scaled-down version of the 2001 Yamama Marine Sport.

item.name: Planes & Helicopters Dealership
item.about: Another distinct dealership located in Downtown Wayfort, where players can purchase aircraft vehicles. item.name: Houses Dealership
item.about: A recently added dealership building located between Ridgeline Pier and the Restin Hotel where it opens up the Blueprint Shop UI to purchase homes. The building from both of the exterior and interior features modern details that are mostly cosmetic. There is also a staircase in the interior of the b

item.name: Drag Race
item.about: Named as the Vine Hill Drag Strip, players can race from the starting point of the Drag Strip to the end.

item.name: Highway Race
item.about: As the name implies, this is a small meetup location found near the Drag Race venue for players to start a highway race.

item.name: Circuit Race
item.about: Named as the Joya Costa Speedway, players will race around a circuit track for two laps.

item.name: Cross Country Race
item.about: Another small meetup location found next to the Police Station for players to start a race around the map.

item.name: Drawbridge Sprint Race
item.about: Another small new meetup location found near the Neighborhood to start a race that involves the drawbridge near the Circuit Race.

item.name: Police Station
item.about: A location that serves as the spawn point for the Police Team found next to the Car Dealership. Players can drive here to pay off their bounty to avoid to getting arrested.

item.name: Criminal Base
item.about: A location that used to serve as the main spawn point for the Criminal Team in downtown Wayfort.

item.name: Customization Garage
item.about: Located near the intersection of Xavier Ave. and Madison St. in the Vine Hill District, is a customization garage featuring three slots for players to customize the appearance or modify the performance their vehicle.

item.name: Neighborhood
item.about: An old location that was revamped in the Housing Update. It features several new roads, buildings, and other small areas that players can hangout in. item.name: Eventfest
item.about: An exclusive location in Vine Hill used to promote the Halloween 2022 Event and the Winter 2022 Event. At one point, the location used to feature three distinct mansion structures that players could not enter. This has now been removed and replaced with the new neighborhood.
